title: Replace diagnostic prints with the logging module across a package
prompt: Replace the diagnostic print() calls in the syncer package with the logging module. Every module that logs gets `logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)`. Progress messages become logger.info; messages that start with "WARNING: " become logger.warning and messages that start with "ERROR: " become logger.error, both without that prefix. Keep the message text otherwise identical. The one summary line printed by syncer/cli.py main() is the program's output and must stay a print(). Do not call logging.basicConfig inside the package modules other than cli.py. Keep the tests passing.
